mechanicTasks.description: We tested the trucks dumping system for the first time; however, it is not operating. The control located beneath the cab seat does not produce any response or sound when activated. Based on discussions with Al, there is no special switch, and the system should operate simply by pressing the controls. It appears that either the electrical system is disconnected or there is a malfunction. It is recommended that the system be inspected by a qualified mechanic.

notes.text: This problem was occurring previously (for about a year), although very occasionally, especially when it was being transported, since the parking brake would stick and this skid steer, unlike the new one, wouldn't start if the parking brake was on. Barney showed me how to fix it at the time; you just had to shake the handbrake a little to get it off. In my opinion, the problem hasn't been correctly identified, and it's recommended to have it evaluated by a Bobcat specialist. You can consult with Barney for his opinion.
